$comment: What our outbound requests reveal about us, per service, and the single source scripts read their User-Agent and identifying parameters from (scripts/outbound_identity.py). Never store a secret, token or e-mail address here: this repo is public. Values that must stay private are named by an env_key, resolved from a private secrets file or the environment. Templates use {identity}; a [bracketed part] is dropped when an identity inside it is unset. Service ids match settings/mandated-services.json where one exists. Rules (Lodewijk, 2026-10-16): his e-mail goes out only where he approved it; registration and keys are his task. Keep this file current whenever a script starts or stops sending something.

lodewijk-email.description: Lodewijk's contact e-mail address; set CONTACT_MAILTO in a private secrets file

user_agent_standard.baseline: Every request: product token and version ({project}), the purpose (research), a public contact URL ({project-url}); no e-mail address unless Lodewijk approved it for that service; never a browser or generic UA (curl, python-requests alone).
user_agent_standard.provider_rules: On top of the baseline, follow each provider's own User-Agent or identification instructions (format, extra tokens, parameters) as its docs state; record them in that service's entry here.
user_agent_standard.source: Lodewijk, 2026-10-20: 'The user agent might have to be different for different APIs, follow their instructions. But let's keep some common standards around'
